key_store.deletion: row delete; purge waits for the cluster xid/xmin horizon to pass the delete, then VACUUM FULL + pg_switch_wal x2 + CHECKPOINT (lab: no archive, replica or backup; freed filesystem blocks not overwritten)
key_store.note: LAB STAND-IN for the client's KMS; every erasure result here is conditional on a KMS with real key deletion
